question: Re-run of CMA-ES Phase 1 (bead 74f.8 / idh4) under the deterministic evaluation default: does tuning the 10 presynaptic parameters beat seed noise on the proxy objective?
command: BIO_FUSED_PRESYN=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node 4 -m scripts.tune_bio_params optimize --distributed --seed 1337 --device cpu --generations 8 --popsize 8 --run-dir runs/cmaes/rerun_2026-10-07
proxy: GPTSynaptic 2L/128d, seq 256, vocab 1024, batch 16, 100 AdamW steps per candidate on the synthetic copy task (second half repeats the first), fitness = mean of the last training losses; stochastic release off
code: 716cacb (online Hebbian still default-on in the proxy model)

measurement_regime.eval_determinism: module-training-flag (GPTSynaptic.forward train_mode defaults to self.training; commit 5cb1a90)

diagnosis: Every candidate scores 6.950-6.951, essentially the uniform-prediction loss ln(1024)=6.931: in 100 steps the proxy model never learns the copy task, so the fitness cannot rank parameter settings and the 7.8e-4 'gain' is below the 2.1e-3 seed-noise floor. The search is optimising noise. A meaningful Phase 1 needs an objective the proxy actually learns (e.g. held-out val bpb on real text after a few hundred steps, which the toy screening shows separates arms at the 1e-2 level), not more generations of this one.
